set.pl: Tweit farm, SE quarter of sec. 14 T105N R24W, Vivian Township (Waseca Co.); "Michael Twite 155.25" on the 1914 Webb atlas
set.t: The money is an obituary rumor only, and no find was reported 1927-32. Check the 1938 aerial for the farmstead by the south line road (sec. 14/23 line). Private land: ask permission first.
pinev: 1914 Webb atlas of Waseca County, Vivian Twp plate: "Michael Twite 155.25" in the SE quarter of sec. 14 T105N R24W, placed from the BLM PLSS grid (about 300 m); a likely heir held the quarter in 1937
